summary: The manuscript establishes three sharp, constructive improvements to the quantitative pillars of Sun & Wang's [5] recent separation AC0 not subset BQAC0/qpoly. First, Theorem A reduces single-layer generalized-Toffoli l1 product-projection weight from 18^k to the exact optimal 3^k via disjoint-gate tensor factorization, exact m=1 spectral diagonal cancellation, and sum-of-squares bounds for m >= 2, matched by a universal lower bound using a multi-qubit dual witness W^{\otimes k}. Second, Theorem B eliminates spurious ln N dependence from Chebyshev filter degrees and collapses weighted log-norms to linear in ln(N/R). Third, Theorem C derives the unique minimax-optimal classical advice bias a^* = M/(2M-1) and establishes exact clause counts M(H_n) <= n for the universal selector CNF Hn, boosting classical-advice advantage guarantees. All 20 core algebraic and combinatorial theorems are fully formalized in Lean 4.35.0 with zero sorry, and all numerical computations are audited by an AST-enforced zero-float Python verifier with 16 SHA-256 certificates.
weaknesses: Highly specialized theoretical quantum complexity domain requiring advanced mastery of product-projection localization and polynomial approximation techniques.
